προκατηχέω.definition: soothe beforehand with sounds, Cels. ap; instruct beforehand, Hld.9.9

προσσαίνω.definition: fawn upon, coax, prop. of dogs, S.Fr.1082

πασιφαής.definition: shining on all, Orph.H.8.14, Man.3.346:—fem. Epigr. in Arist.Mir.843b29

πλῆκτρον.definition: Dor. anything to strike with; spear-point, S.Fr.152 ; of lightning, E.Alc.129 ; a bee's sting, Jul.Or.2.90a

πυριπνέων.definition: Ep. part. with no Verb in use, fire-breathing, Musae.41; must be read in E.Ion203

πρόσμονος.definition: durable, Antyll. ap. Orib.10.29.1. Adv. Id. ap. eund.9.24.25

πλίνθινος.definition: made or built of brick; of clay, Thphr.HP5.9.8; Dicaearch.1.3

παραγωγιάζω.definition: levy toll on ships visiting a port, Plb.3.2.5, 4.44.4 and 46.6

πικράζω.definition: = sq., S.E.P.1.211:—Pass., taste bitter; metaph., Epict.Gnom.22

πρόρρηγμα.definition: membrane enveloping the foetus, Sor.1.57, Paul.Aeg.3.76

πηρώνυμος.definition: named after a wallet, gloss on Tz.ad Lyc.183

πληθικῶς.definition: Adv. in the majority of instances, OGI669.49

περιφρίσσω.definition: c. dat., tremble for, Nonn.D.6.8; bristle with, ib.11.502

περιαμπέχω.definition: cover all over, Id.Phd.98d; later Ph.l.c.: metaph., Philostr.VS2.22

προσήλιος.definition: exposed to the sun, sunny, X.Cyn.4.6; Thphr.Od.40

παυστήριος.definition: fit for ending or relieving; alleviation, Nic.Th.746; Ar.Byz.Arg.S.OT11

πολλαχόθι.definition: Adv. in many places, Plu.Pomp.24, Luc.Herm.30

προσαιτέω.definition: ask besides, Pi.Fr.177.6; demand or require for a purpose, . . Id.Vect.4.39

παραθήγω.definition: whet, sharpen upon; metaph., exasperate, provoke, D.H.8.57; Ph.2.575, cf. 543; incite, Plu.2.1145f

πατραγαθία.definition: virtue of one's father or ancestors, opp. Plu.2.183d, 534c

παλιγγενής.definition: born again, Nonn.D.2.650; generated anew, PMag.Lond.121.510

πολλαχόσε.definition: Adv. towards many sides, into many parts or quarters, Th.2.47: c. gen., X.HG4.4.16

περικλονέω.definition: stir up all round, Q.S.2.649:—Pass., to be massed together, of clouds, Id.3.707

περίμεσος.definition: in the middle: the middle part, AB354

παραπληρόω.definition: Gramm., fill up, of an expletive particle, Trypho ap.A.D.Conj.247.25; Dam.Pr.300

πηξιθάλαττα.definition: she that freezes the sea, Com.Adesp.1118

προσφυή.definition: = II, dub. in; pl., supernumerary teeth, Hippiatr.95

πρωτολογία.definition: right of speaking first in a law-court; right of the leading advocate to speak first, Arg.2 D.20

πολυφωνέω.definition: sound or speak much, gloss on Eust.751.11

πέτασος.definition: also Eratosth. ap. Ath.11.499e; from its shape, broad umbellated leaf, as of the lotus, Thphr.HP4.8.9; Dsc.2.106

παχύστομος.definition: thick at the brim, Henioch.1; metaph., speaking with a broad accent, of the Str.14.2.28:—hence ibid

προδείδω.definition: only aor.1 part. fear prematurely, S.OT90

προοχεύω.definition: impregnate before, Phlp.in GA128.13:—Pass., of eggs, Arist.GA757b2

προδωσείω.definition: Desiderat. of wish to betray, Dam.Isid.173

προπυλίτης.definition: one who pursues his trade in a CIG3028.4

πολυστεφής.definition: decked with many wreaths, A.Eu.39; twisted in many a wreath, Nic.Th.378; of a serpent , ib.490

προσοχθίζω.definition: fut. , to be wroth with; Pass., to be treated with contumely, ib.2 Ki.1.21

πρωΐσπορος.definition: sown or to be sown early, ib.8.1.3

προϊστορέω.definition: make previous inquiry or research; relate by way of introduction, Phlp.in Mete.75.20

παράστημα.definition: in pl., principles, maxims, M.Ant.3.11; of Time, present moment, Porph.Sent.44

προβόλαιος.definition: held out before one, levelled, in rest, Theoc.24.125; alone, = II, Orac. ap. Hdt.7.148

παραιβαδόν.definition: Adv. in going beside or near to, c. gen., prob. in Opp.C.1.484

πλευροτυπής.definition: with striking of the sides, of a cock crowing, AP12.137

πραγματᾶς.definition: = agent or official of a religious guild, IPE2.61, al

προγανόω.definition: cheer or comfort beforehand, Ph.1.104, dub. cj. in 2.416

πρόγραμμα.definition: public proclamation or notice; order of the day, agenda of or D.25.9, Arist.Ath.44.2

πεντάειδος.definition: composed of five ingredients, of a remedy, Aët.15.30

προσάρδω.definition: water or irrigate besides, v.l. in J.BJ3.3.4

πρόκλυτος.definition: heard formerly, of olden time, Il.20.204

προλαλέω.definition: converse first, Antyll. ap. Orib.6.9.1; state, announce before, Eust.1382.24:—Pass., J.AJ15.3.8

παστείλη.definition: last day of the year, EM655.48

πρόσαλσις.definition: leaping against, of the pulse, Agathin. ap. Gal.8.937

πρωτόχνοος.definition: contr. with the first down, Luc.Am.53

πομπίλος.definition: a fish which follows ships, Gasterosteus ductor L., Erinn.1, A.R.Fr.9, et alii ap. Ath.7.282e, al

προσηλόω.definition: nail, rivet, fix to; nail up, D.21.17:—Pass., to be boarded up, SIG799.26

περίβληχρος.definition: very weak: neut. as Adv., even to faintness, A.R.4.621

προδικαστής.definition: one who judges before or for; advocate, SIG134b25, 32

παριππεύω.definition: ride along or over, E.Hel.1665; ride; ride up to, Plb.3.116.3

παρατέμνω.definition: fut. Lacon. Ar.Lys.116cod; cut amiss, make a wrong cut, Thphr.HP6.3.2

περονητρίς.definition: Dor. robe fastened on the shoulder with a buckle or brooch, Theoc.15.21: as Adj., cj. for in AP7.413

πυρικοίτης.definition: Dor. wherein fire lies asleep, of the cane of Prometheus, AP6.294

περίσχεσις.definition: surrounding or taking in flank; Astrol., planetary blockade, Heph.Astr.1.15

πάρδαλις.definition: or , gen. Ep. and; a ravenous sea-fish, Ael.NA9.49, Opp.H.1.368

περιδρομίς.definition: circular track on the top of the walls of Babylon, prob. in Ph. Byz.Mir.5.2

προσεισφέρω.definition: contribute besides, Herm.Hist.2; propose in addition for election, ib.5 .1390.126

πωλέω.definition: Ion.impf. Hdt.1.196: fut; let out the taxes, Aeschin.1.119; Arist.Ath.47.2; SIG284.28

πανομφής.definition: = foreg., Orac. ap. Porph. ap. Eus.PE5.8

πωρόμφαλον.definition: stony concretion in the navel cavity, Gal.19.445

περιπηχύνω.definition: aor. part. take into one's arms, Call.Fr.344

πλαγιάζω.definition: hold aslant, Ach.Tat.Intr.Arat.21; Pass., let the holes be made obliquely, Apollod.Poliorc.151.6; Hierocl.in CA24p.474 M

πανήγυρις.definition: metaph., feast for the eyes, Ael.VH3.1, cf. Lib.Or.59.145; . . destined to exhibit E. as gold and a feast , Eun.Hist.p.236D

προσθύμιος.definition: poet. according to one's mind, welcome, AP6.288

παρρησία.definition: outspokenness, frankness; in bad sense, licence of tongue, Isoc.11.40, cf. Pl.Phdr.240e, Cic.Att.1.16.8

προκτενίζω.definition: comb the scalp before applying hair- restorer, Gal.12.421

πολύβοτος.definition: much-nourishing; having much pasture, Tim.Pers.153; D.H.1.37

προσεγγράφω.definition: carve on, or inscribe, besides; add a saving or limiting clause, Aeschin.3.203

περιπυκάζω.definition: encompass thickly, with foliage, Ach.Tat.1.15:— Med., have thick round, Ctes.Fr.57.11

πολυνεικής.definition: much-wrangling, Id.Th.830 : freq. as pr. n. on which the Trag. are fond of playing, ib.578,658, al

παλαίχθων.definition: that has been long in a country, an ancient inhabitant, indigenous, A.Th.104 ; Epigr. ap. Aeschin.3.190

παρανικάω.definition: subdue to or for evil, pervert, A.Ch.600

πωλητήριον.definition: place where wares are sold, auction-; the office of the who farmed out the metic-tax, D.25.57, cf. Hyp.Fr.270

παράτροπος.definition: turned aside : turned from the right; strange, unusual, Opp.H.1.515, 4.18, cf. Plu.Lys.12

ποιησείω.definition: Desiderat. of desire to do, Hdn.Epim.249

παναληθής.definition: of things, absolutely true or real, Pl.R.583b, cf. Iamb.Protr.4

προϋπογράφω.definition: sketch out, indicate before; subscribe, sign first, Lyd.Mag.2.10

παραύξησις.definition: waxing, Gem.6.29; progressive increase of parallel series, Vett. Val.295.6

πικρότης.definition: pungency, of taste, bitterness; metaph., bitterness, harshness, cruelty, Hdt.1.130; E.El.1014: pl., Isoc.15.300

προθεσμός.definition: in pl., royal privileges or prerogatives, Plu.Nob.3

προσίζω.definition: c. acc., come and sit near, of; metaph., cleave to, E.Fr.910.9 ; Hp.Vict.1.6; the inherent cause, Aret.SD1.7

πάραυλος.definition: dwelling beside; dub. sens. in Michel832.18

περίοχος.definition: Aeol. superior, Sapph.92: Boeot. pre-eminent, restd. in Corinn.2.68

προχειρότης.definition: that which is given in the unworked matter, i.e. the subject-matter of literary works, S.E.M.1.249

παναίτιος.definition: cause of all, A.Ag.1486; to whom all the guilt belongs, opp. A.Eu.200

ποτνιάομαι.definition: cry hence generally, cry aloud in; c. acc., implore loudly, Ph.1.391: c. inf., Id.2.227: abs., ib.65, al

προερεθίζω.definition: irritate before, Gal.12.590, Sor. ap. eund.12.418 ; excite, call forth before the time, Heph.Astr.1.25

προαλείφω.definition: coat, cover beforehand, Aen.Tact.34.1; Med., smear on to oneself beforehand, Hermes Trism. in Cat.Cod.Astr.8.156

πλησμονή.definition: a being filled, satiety, opp; abundance, LXXPr.3.10, Gp.1.10.8

πρωτοπολίτης.definition: first citizen, princeps civitatis, Gloss.: pl., optimates, ib

πανταληθής.definition: all-true, of an oracle, Perdrizet- Lefèbvre Les graffites grecs du Memnonion d' Abydos 493, 500

προσωπικῶς.definition: Adv. in respect of grammatical person, Choerob.in Theod.2.29H

πίθηκος.definition: Dor. ape, monkey; nickname for a trickster, jackanapes, Ar.Ach.907, Av.440, Ra.708, etc. ; of Aeschines, D.18.242

περιθραύω.definition: break small, grind down, Arist.Pr.935b2:—; metaph., crush, Ph.1.564,al

παραδοξάζω.definition: make wonderful or extraordinary, LXX2; put a mark of distinction between, separate, ib.Ex.9.4; ib.8.22

πορφυρίς.definition: purple garment or covering; a purple-coloured bird, Ibyc.4, cf. Ar.Av.304, Call.Fr.100c2

προεξορμάω.definition: set out, start earlier; rush out before the time, Arist.HA587b1

πρωτόπλοος.definition: Att. contr. going to; sailing first or foremost, X.HG5.1.27: pr.n. of Athenian warship, H.E.K. Schmidt Die Namen der attischen Kriegsschiffe7

προηρόσιος.definition: before the time of tillage; the gods in whose honour it was performed, Plu.2.1119e; ib.158d

παραθεωρέω.definition: examine a thing beside another, compare; keep in mind, take into account, . . Epicur.Ep.1p.29U.; Phld.Rh.1.373 S

παρανακύπτω.definition: emerge, come to light: hence, occur, Heracl. ap. Orib.48.8.2

περίφημος.definition: very famous, Archil.63; in bad sense, notorious, Paul.Al.N.3

περιλιμνάζω.definition: surround with water, insulate; intr., become a lake, Ael.NA16.15

πάνδεινος.definition: all-dreadful, terrible; very able, c. inf., Pl.Plt.290b; ironically, D.19.120

παριστία.definition: side-hearth, in the vulgar dialect , Eust.132.32

περίστατος.definition: surrounded and admired by the crowd; Act., standing round and wondering, agape, Theopomp. Com.41

περιήκω.definition: to have come round to one; of Time, to have come round, Plu.Ages.35; Aristid.Or.50.1, cf. Parth.30.2

πολυζωέω.definition: to be full of life, of Isis, IGRom.1.1310

προσανθέω.definition: flower beside, shine beside, c. dat., Philostr.Im.2.5; add lustre to, ib.8, 1.29; Dam.Isid.74

πυρίφευκτος.definition: volatile, vaporizable, Ps.-Democr. ap. Zos.Alch.p.122 B

πολύκοιτος.definition: lying with many women or men, Id.75.9, al

πόρθησις.definition: sack of a town, D.18.70, Plu.Sull.33, etc

περικλίνω.definition: decline, of the sun, Posidon.28; Pass., to be deflected, distorted, Phld.Rh.1.157 S

περιχάσκω.definition: aor. 2 and pf. (as if; open a girdle, Heliod. ap. Orib.48.58.5

πισσόκηρος.definition: a kind of propolis, with which bees line their hives, Arist.HA624a17, Plin.HN11.16

παραδιορθόω.definition: alter for the worse, of stolen verses, Porph. ap. Eus.PE10.3

πτίσις.definition: winnowing of grain, Gal.19.115: pl., Gp.2.34.1

προσπορίζω.definition: Att. fut. procure or supply besides; Math., add, in Pass., Arist.Mete.376a14, Iamb.in Nic.p.47P

πυκτίς.definition: as if picture, AP9.346; parchment codex, Gal.12.423

παχύχυμος.definition: with thick juices, Id.6.261, Alex.Aphr.Pr.1.52, etc

παλίμβαμος.definition: walking back, of women working at the loom, since they had to walk to and fro from side to side, Pi.P.9.18

ποταμηδόν.definition: Adv. like a river, Luc.Sat.7, Aret.SD2.13

πῆχυς.definition: gen. Hp.Fract.2; Anat., ulna, Ruf.Onom.80, Gal.UP2.2, Sor.Fract.20

παραθηλάζω.definition: nurse at the breast as well as another child, BGU1106.30 , etc

περιμάδαρος.definition: bald round about, where the skin peels or scales off all round, Hp.Aph.6.4

παρατίλλω.definition: fut. Ar.Eq.373:—pluck the hair from; Med., pull up weeds, Gp.2.38.2

πίσινος.definition: made of peas, pea- soup, Ar.Eq.1171, Antiph.183.7, Dieuch. ap. Orib.4.8.14, Ael.Ep.4

προΐστημι.definition: fut. aor. 1 part; set over, v.l. for Pl.La.197d

προβίωτος.definition: having had a prior existence, Sophon.in de An.135.1

πολλαχοῦ.definition: Adv. in many places; c. gen., v.l. in Pl.Phd.111a

πρόρρησις.definition: prediction, prognosis, Hp.Prog.15; previous instruction or warning, Th.1.49

πολύκλητος.definition: called from many a land, of the allies of the Trojans, Il.4.438,10.420

πατραλίτωρ.definition: one who sins against a father, dub. in Tz.H.6.443

πολυχίτων.definition: having many coats, Thphr.CP3.21.2, 5.18.2, etc.; of the eyes, Hp.Ep.23

ποντογενής.definition: seaborn, Orph.H.55.2, 81.1:—fem. poet. formed like Opp.C.1.33

πλάνη.definition: wandering, roaming, Hdt.1.30, 2.103, 116; discursive treatment, Pl.Prm.136e; Id.Lg.683a

προαγωγή.definition: leading on, promotion, Posidon.36J; progress, prosperity, OGI223.9

παραναίω.definition: aor. 1 cause to dwell, settle; in Med., aor. 1 = . . D.P.776

πόππυσμα.definition: smacking of lips, clucking, Dexipp.in Cat.11.27: Lat.poppysma, Juv.6.584

πολύκμητος.definition: wrought with much toil, Hom; later, laborious, AP9.656.6; Q.S.7.424

πρωτοβολέω.definition: throw first, take the first shot; shed the first teeth, Hippiatr.95, Gp.16.1.13

προσσεύω.definition: pf. part. Pass. rushing upon, Q.S.8.166

πελάθω.definition: collat. form of , only pres., used by Trag. in lyr. and anap., A.Fr.132, E.Rh.557, El.1293, cf. Ar.Th.58

προφθάνω.definition: outrun, anticipate, c. acc; abs., to be beforehand, E.Ph.1385, Theo Sm.p.160H.: aor. Med., A.R.4.913

παράκουσμα.definition: thing heard amiss, false notion; in pl., defects of hearing, Gal.7.108

περιορύσσω.definition: Att. dig round, dig; dig up around, Plu.Rom.20

πλόκος.definition: lock of hair, braid, curl, A.Ch.197; wreath or chaplet, the parsley- wreath at the Isthmian games, Pi.O.13.33; E.El.778; Id.Med.841 ; ib.786

περιστομίς.definition: wooden gauge or spanner for; iron clamp, Apollod.Poliorc.155.11

πηγανηρά.definition: rue-plaster, Antyll. ap. Paul.Aeg.7.17, Alex.Trall.5.4. :—also Aët.15.40

παρένταξις.definition: in Tactics, insertion, e.g. of light-armed troops among hoplites, Ascl.Tact.6.1

παρακενόω.definition: empty beside or near, void, vacuum, Placit.4.22.1, 5.15.3

περιαμύνω.definition: defend or guard all round, Plu.Alc.7

πανδήμιος.definition: of or belonging to all the people, public beggar, Od.18.1; a draught of all kinds of fish, AP9.383.2

πολύμετρος.definition: of many measures: hence, copious; written in many metres, Ath.13.608e

προσαντλέω.definition: draw and pour upon, Dsc.4.64 ; bathe, foment, Herod.Med. ap. Orib.10.37.11, Antyll. ap. eund.9.23.11

παγίδιον.definition: Dim. of snare, gin, prob. in Vett. Val.284.26

προφύλαξ.definition: advanced guard: =; officer on guard, Aen.Tact.22.9, and so prob. in IGRom.4.455 .— Also fem., Eratosth.Cat.22

πρόβλημα.definition: anything thrown forward; hindrance, obstacle, Hp.Nat.Mul.67, Mul.1.20, Ael.NA2.13

πρωτολόγος.definition: speaking first, and so =; the chief magistrate at Aphrodisias, CIG2760, al.; at Iconium, ib.3992

παντότης.definition: all-ness, i. e. integrality, opp. , Dam.Pr.158,al., Simp.in Ph.785.8; Procl.in Ti.1.426, cf. ib.390

πρωτοκύων.definition: first dog, i.e. chief of the Cynics, AP11.154

πιεσμός.definition: = Hp.Nat.Puer.21 , Eust.1181.63: metaph., in pl., constraint, pressure of circumstances, Epicur.Nat.28.3

προνικάω.definition: gain a victory beforehand, Th.2.89 , Is.11.18, etc

παραβάκτρος.definition: near or like a staff, with service as of a staff, E.Ph.1548

περιλάπτω.definition: suck or lick all round, Pherecr.23

προπαθής.definition: suffering before, f.l. for in Ph.2.595

προεμπίπτω.definition: fall on or into before; protrude into, c. dat., Gal.UP7.7; of a bear trying to bite a net, Plu.2.918f

παρεμποδών.definition: Adv. in the way, Procop. Gaz.Ep.127, Alex. Trall.2

προσμισθόω.definition: let out for hire besides, put; give a contract for besides, IG12.374.127:— Pass., ib.370.11

παχύτης.definition: thickness, of stalks, skin; thickness or sediment of liquor, Hdt.4.23; density, Hp.Aph.6.41; thick consistency, Arist.PA668b2, 676a11; Ascl.Tact.12.10

πτεροφόρος.definition: feathered, winged, A.Ag.1147; under the Roman Emperors, as Subst., courier, Plu.Oth.4; cf. II

πολύευκτος.definition: much-prayed-for, much-desired; Act., with many prayers, Nonn.D.40.66

πορφυρεύω.definition: catch purple fish, Philostr.VA1.24:—Med; dye purple, in Pass., Acus.37J

πλανόδιος.definition: going by by-paths, wandering, h.Merc.75 metri gr.]; cf

περιφοιτάω.definition: wander about, prov; c. acc., Hp.Vict.1.6; Philostr.VSPraef

πεῖραρ.definition: Ep., Ion., and Lyr. form of end, limit, Il.8.478, cf. Od.5.463, 11.13. 2. completion, the end of our labours, 23.248. 3. achievement, execution, mode or means of execution, Il.23.350: Pi.P.4.220: says he possesses the…

πινάριον.definition: a sort of vitriol, Dsc.[5.98]; piece of mother-of-pearl , PHolm.3.12, PSI3.183.5

παραγγελία.definition: command or order issued to soldiers; summoning one's partisans to support one in a suit at law, exertion of influence, D.19.1, 283

προάστιον.definition: house or estate in the suburbs, Philostr.VA1.7, VS2.1.11

περιποίησις.definition: keeping safe, preservation; concrete, those who are saved, Ep.Eph.1.14

πρότασις.definition: putting forward: in; in Logic, proposition, Arist.APr.24a16: esp. premiss of a syllogism, ib.42a32; the minor premiss, Id.EN1143b3, 1147b9; = Plu.2.1009c, al

περίτριμμα.definition: anything worn smooth by rubbing; Medic., preparation for rubbing in, Crito ap.Gal.12.447

πρόσλοιπος.definition: left over and above, IG22.1672.239; of time, for the future, Ephes.2.29

παράφασις.definition: only in poet. forms; allurement, persuasion, in the cestus of Aphrodite, Il.14.217; deceitful speaking, Pi.N.8.32

παρώνυμος.definition: formed by a slight change, derivative; Subst. by-name, Pherecyd.25 J

περιξυστήρ.definition: surgical instrument for scraping or smoothing bones, Heliod.ap.Orib.46.11.29

πυγμάχος.definition: one who fights with the fist, boxer, Od.8.246, Pi.I.8.68, Luc.JTr.33

περιτενής.definition: stretched all round, distended, Hp.Art.46, Paul.Aeg.5.8; glossed by Erot., Greg.Cor.p.556 S

περιπλοκή.definition: twining round, interlacing; in the philos. of Epicurus, interlacing of atoms, Ep.1p.8 U., 2p.44 U. , al.; Arist.Fr.208

παππίζω.definition: = coax or wheedle one's father, Ar.V.609, cf. Eust.565.32

προεπαφίημι.definition: send forward against the enemy, Luc.Tox.54

πατρόθεν.definition: Adv., from or after a father; coming from, sent by one's father, imposed by Zeus, Pi.O.3.28; A.Ag.1507 ; a father's curse, Id.Th.841

προαφίημι.definition: release first, let some blood before, Hp.Vid.Ac.3; dismiss first, D.C.37.50

προσεικάζω.definition: aor. make like, assimilate; I am not able to guess by comparison, ib.163 ; conjecture in addition, Str.3.5.8

προσευπορέω.definition: procure or provide besides; solve a difficulty, or acquire insight, in addition, Procl.in Euc.p.66 F., cf. Hyp.7.57

πελεκητής.definition: hewer of wood or stone, Gloss. , restd. in IG12.349.20

προεκφέρω.definition: put out before, LXXGe.38.28; utter, pronounce before, Demetr.Eloc.51

πυρρίζω.definition: to be red or ruddy, LXXLe.13.19, al

πάγχριστος.definition: thoroughly anointed: without a Subst. in a corrupt passage, S.Tr.661

παράχυσις.definition: pouring in, i.e. fraudulent watering of wine, BCH50.214

παρακόπτω.definition: strike falsely, counterfeit, prop. of; Med., cheat or swindle out of a thing, Id.Eq.807; simply, cheat, ib.859:—Pass., to be cheated, Id.Nu.640

πολυστέφανος.definition: with many wreaths or crowns; Subst., = Feronia, Gloss

παραίσσω.definition: Att. dart past, Il.5.690; 8.98; 20.414; Ar.V.988, cf. 837: c. acc., Il.11.615: in later Prose, Plu.2.774f. in Hom.]

προσαίσσω.definition: Att. spring or rush to, Od.22.337,342,365; a cloud comes over my eyes, A.Pr.145 ; in Prose, of flames, Aen.Tact.34.2; also of persons, ChioEp.13.1

παρά.definition: + gen.: da (provenienza da persona); + dat.: presso; + acc.: lungo, presso, oltre, contro

περί.definition: + gen.: intorno a, riguardo a; + dat.: intorno a (raro); + acc.: attorno a, verso

ποτέ.definition: enclitica: una volta, un tempo, mai (in domande: τίς ποτε; chi mai?)

προσεῖπον.definition: rivolsi la parola a, salutai (+ acc.): aor. II di προσαγορεύω/προσλέγω

προεῖδον.definition: previdi, vidi in anticipo: aor. II di προοράω

πόρω.definition: diedi, procurai, destinai: tema πορ-/πρω- senza presente; aor. II ἔπορον; pf. m.-p. impers. πέπρωται: è destinato (ἡ πεπρωμένη: il destino)

παμφανόων.definition: tutto splendente [epico]: ptc. di παμφαίνω (πᾶν + φαίνω) con diectasi omerica

περιδείδω.definition: temere assai (per qualcuno: + dat./gen.) [epico]: pf. περιδείδια con valore di presente
